title: span description API: description= is stored only as the mlflow.spanDescription attribute, threaded through every tracing entry point
answers: How do I add a human-readable description to a traced function or span in MLflow?
My async or generator function lost its span description after I added a new keyword to @mlflow.trace, what do I update?
Where is a span's description read from or written to on the span object?
Can I change a span's description after the span has already started?
body:
Path: mlflow/tracing/fluent.py:trace (decorator, all overloads) accepts description= for functions, coroutines and generators via _wrap_function and _wrap_generator; mlflow/tracing/fluent.py:start_span and start_span_no_context accept description= for context-manager and detached spans. mlflow/entities/span.py:Span.description reads it back and LiveSpan / NoOpSpan.set_description writes it.
Rule: Keep the value only in the attribute SpanAttributeKey.DESCRIPTION ("mlflow.spanDescription", mlflow/tracing/constant.py:SpanAttributeKey) so the getter, the setter and span.attributes agree. When adding a similar span-level kwarg, add it to trace's overloads and implementation, pass it through _wrap_function and _wrap_generator, and in start_span and start_span_no_context set the attribute only when the value is not None. Add the matching setter to NoOpSpan so no-op spans accept the call.
Constraints: Default None must leave the attribute absent (no empty key). set_description after start overwrites the earlier value. Public method additions also belong in docs/api_reference/api_inventory.txt. Rendering the description in the UI is not part of this path.
Applies: Any change to span-level metadata kwargs or setters on the Python tracing API (trace, start_span, start_span_no_context, LiveSpan, NoOpSpan).
applies: Span-level convenience options on the Python tracing API; not for autologging integrations or UI rendering, which do not go through this path.
says: Add human readable descriptions to traced functions and spans in the tracing API.
Updating a span description dynamically after the span has already started.
Traced generator and asynchronous functions are missing their configured span descriptions.
Allow setting custom description text on context manager spans and detached spans.
Span descriptions are not persisting correctly on trace spans when inspecting attributes.
search: In the Python tracing API (mlflow/tracing/fluent.py and mlflow/entities/span.py), span descriptions passed via description= to trace, start_span, and start_span_no_context are stored solely as the SpanAttributeKey.DESCRIPTION ('mlflow.spanDescription') attribute. Values are read through Span.description, modified with LiveSpan.set_description and NoOpSpan.set_description, and passed through _wrap_function and _wrap_generator for functions, coroutines, and generators. When adding span metadata kwargs, leave the attribute absent when None, update trace overloads, and register public methods in docs/api_reference/api_inventory.txt without affecting UI rendering.
